swe: Gruppen leds av Rickard Carlsson som är docent i psykologi. Rickards forskning har framförallt fokuserat på meta-vetenskap och han har bland annat grundat tidskriften Meta-Psychology som är världens mest öppna tidskrift. Det är dessutom en av mycket få vetenskapliga tidskrifter som faktiskt kontrollerar resultaten före publicering. Rickard är även utbildad svensklärare för högstadiet och gymnasiet.
eng: The group is led by Associate Professor Rickard Carlsson. Rickard's research has primarily focused on meta-science, and he has, among other things, founded the journal Meta-Psychology, which is the world's most open journal. It is also one of the very few scientific journals that actually verify results before publication. Rickard is also an upper-secondary and high-school teacher in Swedish.
